sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Energy Crisis is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey friend, I could use some help. It takes an incredible amount of energy to sustain my current activities, especially considering my farm, the one you helped me with resources for. I usually order fuel from other sources, but unfortunately, there is no way to contact the supplier at the moment. Do you think there are still unexhausted fuel tanks left somewhere? I think there should have been something left in the cape area. Can you check it out, mercenary?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 25 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find and mark the group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
- Find and mark the first tanker truck with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
- Find and mark the second tanker truck with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
- Find and mark the third tanker truck with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +13,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 75,000 Roubles
  - 78,750 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 86,250 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- Unlocks purchase of FN SCAR-L 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant Contract Wars) at Ref LL3
- Unlocks purchase of Tromix Monster Claw 12ga muzzle brake at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front) at Prapor LL4
"Great, mercenary. This information opens up many possibilities for me. I'll gather people to collect the fuel. Thank you very much, friend."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 4 | Required | N/A | This item is placed on the trucks and tanks. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |

For this quest you have to find and mark a group of fuel tanks and three tanker trucks on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
- It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
- The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work
